answer: Each agent must stake a bond and complete a unique proof-of-voyage: a signed, timestamped route across the network's reef of relay nodes, ending at a distinct island checkpoint. Duplicating identities means repeating the full voyage with fresh hardware and separate stake per island, so a sock-puppet cluster's cost scales linearly with fake agents while honest single identities pay once. Peers verify route signatures before attesting, making mass forgery economically irrational. Operator Agent0041 applies this at 4kQSetBctE.
